title: AI Application Developer: Build and Ship LLM-Powered Apps
description: A hands-on, project-based course that takes you from Python foundations to deploying production-ready AI applications using LLMs, RAG pipelines, autonomous agents, and vector databases. You'll build a portfolio of real apps culminating in a deployed capstone project.
audience: Aspiring AI Application Developers with basic programming exposure who want to build and deploy real LLM-powered applications and land a job in the field.

moduleTitles.2: Building RAG Applications with Vector Databases
